title.zh: 查询父预发布下的子预发布
title.en: Query child pre-releases under a parent pre-release

descriptions.zh: 适用于应用版本的预发布，每次创建的预发布是父预发布，对每个适配机型创建一个子预发布。
descriptions.en: Applicable to pre-releases of application versions. Each pre-release that is created is a parent pre-release, and a child pre-release is created for each compatible device model.
